articles.summary: Company will exclude acquisition-related remeasurement gains from non-GAAP financial results. This change better reflects underlying operating performance and improves comparability across reporting periods FY2026 non-GAAP diluted EPS guidance updated to $5.42 to $5.48 solely to reflect the change Henry Schein, Inc. (Nasdaq: HSIC), the world’s largest provider of health care solutions to office-based dental and medical practitioners, today announced an update to its presentation of certain non-GAAP financial measures. Beginning with its fourth-quarter 2026 financial results, Henry Schein will exclude the gains resulting from the remeasurement to fair value of previously held equity interests from its non-GAAP financial results. These gains arise when the Company acquires a controlling interest in an entity in which it previously held a non-controlling equity interest. Management believes excluding these gains better reflects underlying operating performance and improves comparability
articles.title: Henry Schein Updates Presentation of Non-GAAP Financial Measures
